summary: Keep incumbent observation and work delivery running while an explicit restart waits for preparation, without starting a competing launch-drift replacement.

replay.detail: No claim formats or replay behavior change.

rules.detail: Restart authority and admission rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: An idle incumbent continues receiving ready-work messages while an explicit restart waits for preparation. Launch drift cannot bypass that preparation. Plain restarts retain their acknowledgment-or-two-minute-deadline behavior; fresh sessions still require their handoff.

downtime.detail: No upgrade restart or downtime requirement is introduced.

recovery.detail: Rollback requires no state conversion; pending restart claims remain readable.
